subject: bench: 4-arm context-injection runner
description:
Create a 4-arm bench runner for the context-injection experiment.

Arms:
  ARM 0 (baseline) — bench-arm.js arm=off  (no MCP, no injection)
  ARM 1 (global)   — bench-arm.js arm=on   --with-global-summary
  ARM 2 (window)   — bench-arm.js arm=on   --with-window
  ARM 3 (both)     — bench-arm.js arm=on   --with-global-summary --with-window

Script: /Users/imyu/Desktop/zonoid/scripts/bench-context-inject.js
Usage:  node scripts/bench-context-inject.js --problem <name> --trials 3

For each arm x trial: invoke bench-arm.js, record arm/trial/problem/pass/weighted_cost/full_lifecycle_tokens, append to bench/context-inject/results.jsonl.

Reuse ACCEPTANCE map from bench-arm.js for pass/fail. Reuse weightedCost() from bench-economy.js. Full lifecycle cost = ALL tokens across the task transcript.

summary: Implemented scripts/bench-context-inject.js — 4-arm runner that invokes bench-arm.js with ORCH_GATE_OFF=1 across arms (baseline OFF, global-summary ON, sliding-window ON, both ON), N trials each. Extracts full-lifecycle token metrics from transcripts, computes weightedCost (input×1 + output×5 + cache_read×0.1 + cache_creation×1.25), appends per-run JSONL to bench/context-inject/results.jsonl. Merged to main at adffb3f.
